SEB-301: the gas read asks funded wallets that do not revert, and RPCs that answer both calls (#737)

Binance 14 (the probe sender) held 1.35M USDT on 31 Oct and every real node still answered execution reverted for it, so no hour since collection resumed had a gas reading. The read now tries four funded wallets in turn per node, on publicnode, drpc and tenderly. cloudflare-eth.com, my earlier second RPC, answers eth_estimateGas but refuses eth_gasPrice, so it is gone. Errors keep 150 characters per RPC instead of 80. CLAUDE.md: a test never asserts anything about live data that collection can change.

SEB-301: a failed gas read no longer costs the hour its route rows (#732)

collector.py: the gas read tries the first RPC twice, then a second public keyless RPC (cloudflare-eth.com). If both fail, gas_readings.csv gets a source_ok=false row with the error, the corridor sample is still written with gas:missing in its errors column and every gas-dependent figure blank (nothing invented, nothing reused), and the step exits 0.
emit_routes.py: such an hour is not priced and the route's gaps list says the on-chain leg was not read that hour.
check_collection_run.py: a step that exits non-zero fails the gate only if it wrote no rows; a gas-only miss counts as a corridor that answered.
